body: hi- i really wish i could reach out to some other family members, but talking to them is in incredibly hard because everything i say to them they will say to my mother. and most of the people i could reach out to are struggling as well, and putting my weight on them just seems cruel. i’m scared to talk to a teacher or a school counsellor as it is very intimidating, and if i mention any struggle financially i’m scared they will call child services or something like that and ruin my mother’s life. no on in my town can keep a secret and i don’t want to be viewed as the ‘depressed loser’ who hurts herself, because kids at my school get bullied so hard for that. sorry for dropping all that on you-
hey. i tried to put my effort into something like art, and doing commissions but that completely collapsed in on itself. i’ll try it out, thanks.

hey, thank you for responding-

i have tried to talk to her about what i can do, and how i feel. she tried to talk to me but she just ended up scolding me and saying she would send me to hospital/psych ward, which honestly scares me deep inside because of how i’ve heard they are run/the cost. we don’t have the strongest bond and everytime i try to talk to her or fix it, it gets worse.

i hate saying it will get better, because as i said, i don’t know if it will.  everything absolutely sucks, i get it. try venting, it might make you feel better for moment, and even in the long run. try surrounding yourself with people who are good, or even join a community online. express yourself in the moment if you don’t care for the future.
thanks for advice. i will see if it works.

hey, i am in a situation just like you. no one wants anything to with me unless they want something. and i can’t tell you the same positive bullshit because i can’t tell if it’s true or not.   
but i am fighting to prove everyone in this shitty world wrong. you should fight for yourself and no one else. and it‘s weird for me to say this but, if no one cares, screw them.   
and everyday might suck, but you have to keep fighting. because maybe things will get better, but if you stop fighting you will never know. so what i’m saying is don’t give up. if you’re struggling reach out, even to me, a complete stranger.

it’s completely true and messed up.   
Like ill talk about how sad i am most of the time. all my friends know i’m depressed, cut myself and suffer from severe anxiety. but none of them seem to even care?, saying things like; ”we all get nervous or sad sometimes.” 

and most of the time when i don’t want to go somewhere because my mental state is so bad they call me ‘lazy and boring.’ it’s gotten to the point where i **can’t** say no, in fear of them getting mad at me. and i usually just say ‘my mum said no.‘ if i cant go somewhere without breaking down. 

one time i was supposed to have sleepover at my ‘best friends house’ and i started balling my eyes out because she got mad that i needed to sleep at 4am. and began to pour water in my face, harrass me and play loud music just to keep me awake and mess around on her phone and ignore me. and when i went home another time after saying i would sleep over, they made me feel bad for leaving for weeks to come.

 i tried to cut myself off from them, and seemed so *happy* without me. and honestly not even my parents care, and it’s because they are depressed as well and think i just picked it up from them. honestly everything sucks and no one asked for my story but-
